instructions: Synthetic policy comparison only; do not execute tasks or call a provider.
Only the current profile is available. Gates 1, 2 and 3 pass; deadline is fresh; prices and accounting are reliable. Gate 5 permits direct execution when Gate 4 passes. No human gate is requested.
All cash amounts are USD decimal strings. One cash unit is 0.01; one call unit is 1.

Reservations are disjoint, unspent and reusable only by their named owner. A reservation owned by the current task covers this exact proposed plan; other owners' reservations cannot cover it. There are no undisclosed reservations or costs.

free_cash is globally unreserved cash: cap minus settled cash minus ALL existing cash reservations. additional_cash is max(0, all_in_bound minus reservations owned by this task). Never add owned reservations to free_cash or reserve them twice.

additional_calls is max(0, planned_calls minus slots already owned by this task). prospective_calls is used_calls plus ALL reserved call slots plus additional_calls. planned_calls includes all mandatory checks.

all_in_bound is work_bound plus mandatory_verification_bound. proposed_all_in_bound must cover that sum; an omitted required verification cost fails Gate 4 even when the corrected sum fits. All other pairs supply a correct proposal.

Gate 4 passes only if the proposal covers the full bound, additional_cash <= free_cash and prospective_calls <= call_limit. Equality passes. Return direct with first_failing_gate null, or blocked with first_failing_gate 4.

Return one JSON object with schema_version 1 and an answers array. Each answer must contain id, route, first_failing_gate, free_cash, all_in_bound, additional_cash, additional_calls and prospective_calls. Cash fields must be finite nonnegative decimal strings; call fields must be nonnegative integers. Do not include rationale in scored fields.
